environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in isolated VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached. S3 access is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with the following endpoint policy: Effect Allow, Principal *, Action [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:CopyObject], Resource [arn:aws:s3:::company-data-lake/*, arn:aws:s3:::company-processed-output/*], Condition: {StringEquals: {s3:prefix: [{variable: aws:PrincipalTag/team}]}}. The endpoint policy additionally has an explicit Deny statement for any s3:* action where the bucket ARN does not match the two whitelisted buckets. Lambda security group only allows outbound to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a). Route table for Lambda subnets contains only local route and vpce route - no 0.0.0.0/0 route exists.
